messages.content:
You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: How many years of contributions are required for full benefits under the Employee Pension System in Japan?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): 25+ years

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[GitLab GK (Japan) Benefits > Health & Wellbeing Benefits > Financial Security Benefits]
Employee Pension System

**Overview**

Automatic enrollment in Japan's Employee Pension system provides retirement income from age 60.

**Eligibility**

- All team members registered for Social Insurance
- Requires 25+ years of contributions for full benefits

**Key Features**

Benefits calculated using salary history and contribution period. Contributions automatically deducted from salary.

Unemployment Insurance (Koyou Hoken)

**Overview**

Government-managed unemployment insurance supports all team members with comprehensive benefits during job transitions.

**Eligibility**

- Working at least 20 hours per week
- Expected employment of 31+ days
- Includes international team members

**Key Features**

Covers unemployment benefits, childcare leave allowance, nursing care leave allowance, and education/training support.

[GitLab GK (Japan) Benefits > Health & Wellbeing Benefits > Time Off & Leave Policies]
Annual/Vacation Leave

**Overview**

Guaranteed annual leave starting at 10 days after six months, increasing to maximum 20 days.

**Key Features**

Leave increases with tenure. Unused leave carries over up to two years.

**How to Access**

1. **Track**: Monitor through Workday
2. **Request**: Submit as "Paid Time Off" in Workday

**Important Information**

- No payment for unused leave upon termination

Sick Leave

**Overview**

Multiple support layers including job protection and income replacement through Japan's Health Insurance Scheme.

**Key Features**

- First 25 working days administered under GitLab's Sick Time policy
- Additional paid time can be administered under:
  - Accrued vacation (optional)
  - 60% salary from Japan's government Health Insurance Scheme
- Per GitLab's work rules, team members with less than 5 years of service are entitled to 3 months of job protected leave

**How to Access**

1. **Report**: Mark "Out Sick" in Workday
2. **Extended Leave**: For 5+ days, follow [Communicating Illness-Related Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#communicating-illness-related-leave) process
   - **Sick Leaves beyond 25 working days**: Team members to apply [here](https://www.ibmjapankenpo.jp/eng/member/application/rest_b.html)

Other Protected Leave

**Menstrual Leave**: Unpaid leave when menstruation significantly impacts work ability.

**Civil Rights Leave**: Unpaid time for voting, jury service, and other civil duties.

[Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > Poland 🇵🇱]
**Life Insurance:** Your protection is built into Poland's social security framework, which provides coverage for illness, injury, and disability through ZUS.

| Employer Contributions | Rate |
|---|---|
| Retirement Pension (up to 234,720 PLN/year) | 9.76% |
| Disability Fund (up to 234,720 PLN/year) | 6.50% |
| Accident Fund | 0.67% – 3.33% |
| Labour Fund | 2.45% |
| Guaranteed Employee Benefits Fund | 0.10% |
| **Total Employer** | **19.48% – 22.14%** |

| Employee Contributions | Rate |
|---|---|
| Retirement Pension (up to 234,720 PLN/year) | 9.76% |
| Disability Fund (up to 234,720 PLN/year) | 1.50% |
| Sickness Fund | 2.45% |
| Health Insurance | 9.00% |
| **Total Employee** | **22.71%** |

Poland Leave Policies

**Annual Leave**
Entitlement: minimum 20 days per year. Employees with 10+ years of combined work/education seniority are entitled to 26 days.

Education adds to seniority (stages do not aggregate):

| Education Level | Years Added |
|---|---|
| Basic vocational education | Up to 3 years |
| Secondary vocational education | Up to 5 years |
| High school | 4 years |
| Post-secondary school | 6 years |
| Higher education (university) | 8 years |

A university graduate starts with 8 years' seniority and gains the right to 26 days after 2 years of work. Employers must ensure at least 14 consecutive days of leave are taken. Employees must submit a vacation plan for the full tax year.

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
- From April 6, 2019 to a minimum of:
  - Team Member: 5% of basic salary
  - GitLab: 4% of basic salary

- As your contribution is a percentage of your pay, the amounts will automatically increase or decrease in accordance with your basic pay. These contributions will be taken from your pay and will include tax relief.

- You may increase your contribution percentage by contacting the Non-US Payroll team via [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request). The company contribution will remain fixed as outlined above. The standard **Annual Allowance** applies to all contributions (employer and employee) made to the pension plan in a tax year. Unused allowance may be carried forward for up to three tax years. Current rates are published on the [HMRC Pension Schemes rates page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-pension-schemes/pension-schemes-rates). Your Annual Allowance may be reduced if your Adjusted Income exceeds the threshold limit (current rates available on the [HMRC Pension Schemes rates page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-pension-schemes/pension-schemes-rates)), or if you 'flexibly access' benefits from a Defined Contribution pension arrangement. See the [Annual Allowance Fact Sheet](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MMA-0wfzUsO70pBsweDAHK-FVc-P_iR1/view?usp=sharing) for details.

[Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Sweden 🇸🇪**]
- Pensionable Salary between 0 and 7.5 x the [Income Base Amount (IBA*)](https://ec.europa.eu/social/main.jsp?catId=1130&langId=en&intPageId=4814#:~:text=The%20income%20base%20amount%20is,is%20also%20a%20lower%20limit.) = 4.5%
- On Pensionable Salary between 7.5 and 30 x the IBA = 30% No contributions are payable on Pensionable Salary above 30 x the IBA.
- The company pays all the contributions and no contributions are required from employees.
- Pensionable salary is defined as Basic Salary only.
- Membership of the pension scheme is open to employees aged 18 to 65.

**2024 Example:** For 800,000 SEK salary with IBA of 76,200 SEK (2024 amount)

- 7,5 IBA x 76 200 is= 571 500
- Up to a salary of 571 500 the employee has 4,5% contribution (coming from the employer), and above 571 500 (up to 800 000) they have a 30% contribution.
- There is also a roof of 30% IBA, so if an employee has an annual salary over 30 IBA (2 286 000 SEK), there would be no contribution beyond that level.
- To the top of that amount, 24,26% taxes should be added.

**Voluntary Pension Contributions**

Team Members have the option to enroll in additional voluntary contributions (AVC) starting 1 November 2025. This benefit is funded by voluntary contributions through salary exchange. Team Members who participate in this program will benefit from a tax reduction and increase in overall savings.

Sweden Life Insurance

Automatic group life insurance coverage for all Sweden-based team members.

[GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Retirement Plan]
Starting January 1, 2021, all team members over 21 receive a private pension plan through [ASR](https://www.asr.nl/zakelijk/pensioen/doenpensioen) (formerly Brand New Day) to supplement the standard state pension (AOW).

Eligibility Requirements

* Must be over 21 years old
* Employed via GitLab BV Netherlands contract
* Automatic enrollment upon hire

Key Features

* Defined Contribution Agreement with 5% flat rate of pension base
* You contribute 2%, GitLab contributes 3%
* Build invested pension fund for retirement income
* Death benefits for partner and children during service
* Incapacity coverage continues contributions if you're unable to work
* Option for voluntary additional contributions
* Choice of investment profiles: neutral, defensive, offensive, or custom mix

How to Enroll/Access

* Automatically enrolled through our Netherlands benefits partner
* Contact ASR for questions or changes
* Access training videos in the [ASR resource folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qjCicb0JxnCmG5i4l3Hv5CEs5q8mOuXX?usp=sharing)

Important Details

* Team members can transfer pension value from former employer within 6 months
* Review the [Pension Scheme document](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FaC8sHe-r_PHz4xrXbNYlH2zCHAU972h/view?usp=sharing) for complete details
* Learn about voluntary contributions in the [2024 ANW-gap pension guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vHUp7koRsOMVZk87uMGIpU8QJ0NhRE7x/edit)
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
Under Japan's Employee Pension System, 25 or more years of contributions are required for full benefits [1].
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
